camera_world_to_cv — DRIVE pegsim op

• Data kinds: matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.camera_world_to_cv(cam_xmat, cam_xpos) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsim; pegsim.camera_world_to_cv(cam_xmat, cam_xpos) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("camera_world_to_cv"))

Usage

Converts a MuJoCo camera pose (d.cam_xmat 3×3 = camera axes in the world, d.cam_xpos) to OpenCV / Fullseye extrinsic parameters: X_cv = R X_w + t, R = diag(1, −1, −1) Rwcᵀ, t = −R p (MuJoCo looks along −Z with +Y up; OpenCV has +Z forward and +Y down).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り: R(3×3)、t(3,)、R_cam_to_world = Rᵀ。numpy だけ(mujoco 不要)。Raises ValueError: 形が違う、R が回転でない。
